sentences.en: The teacher is likely to get angry with the students.
sentences.zh: 老师可能会生学生的气。

sentences.en: I was angry about missing that film at the cinema.
sentences.zh: 我因为错过了那部电影而生气。

sentences.en: He was angry at the suggestion that he was dishonest.
sentences.zh: 他一听到说自己不诚实就很生气。

senses.zh: 生气的,愤怒的，发怒的,（颜色等）刺目的,（伤口等）发炎的

collocations.en: be angry at/with/about be angry with
Please don't be angry with me
